item.title: Schumer blasts Trump’s Iran war as failure, moves to rein in his war powers amid ceasefire
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., plans to force another war powers vote to rein in President Donald Trump's use of the military in Iran amid a fragile ceasefire.

item.title: Iran threatens to end ceasefire over Hezbollah's exclusion from truce deal
item.summary: Iran says the U.S. must choose between ceasefire or war via Israel as Tuesday's ceasefire deal excludes Tehran-backed terrorist group Hezbollah.

item.title: Michael Moore calls Democratic Party 'cowards' who actually support Iran war
item.summary: Michael Moore claimed Democratic Party leadership supports the Iran conflict after arguing President Donald Trump made a "holocaust" level threat against the country.

item.title: Democratic lawmaker warns he's 'taking names,' creating list of people who need to be held accountable
item.summary: Rep. Jason Crow said Tuesday that Democrats are "taking names" in response to a reported Trump DOJ "enemies" list, vowing to seek accountability against the administration.

item.title: WATCH: Leavitt slaps down critics who called Trump's Iran threat a bluff
item.summary: Karoline Leavitt says Trump's threat to destroy Iranian civilization was not a bluff, claiming it forced Iran to agree to a two-week ceasefire deal.

item.title: Warriors' Draymond Green floats NBA tanking fix, says play-in tournament 'ain't working'
item.summary: Draymond Green proposes the NBA fine teams more aggressively for tanking, arguing the league is quick to punish players but not team misconduct.

item.summary: Snag these genuine Swarovski earrings, necklaces, bracelets and jewelry sets while they're up to 55% off on Amazon.

item.title: Kirk Cousins reveals how a FaceTime call with Tom Brady sealed his decision to join the Raiders
item.summary: Kirk Cousins credited Tom Brady for giving him a big nudge toward signing with the Las Vegas Raiders, calling their FaceTime conversation "life-giving."

item.title: Deadly bacterial disease could be stopped with common pantry staple, study suggests
item.summary: A high-protein diet rich in casein and wheat gluten could "disarm" cholera bacteria, cutting infection levels by 100-fold, a new UC Riverside study finds.

item.title: Davey Lopes, four-time All-Star and one of MLB's greatest base stealers, dead at 80
item.summary: Davey Lopes, a four-time MLB All-Star and 1981 World Series champion with the Dodgers, has died at 80. He ranks 26th all-time in stolen bases.
